tools.name: recallai_list_bots
tools.description: List meeting bots in the workspace with their status, meeting URL and schedule. Use it to find a bot id. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/bot/.

tools.name: recallai_get_bot
tools.description: Get one meeting bot: its status changes, recordings, meeting URL and settings. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/bot/{id}/.

tools.name: recallai_list_recordings
tools.description: List recordings, optionally for one bot. A recording holds the media and transcript shortcuts. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/recording/.

tools.name: recallai_get_recording
tools.description: Get one recording: its status, expiry and media_shortcuts (download URLs for video, audio, transcript, participant events). Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/recording/{id}/.

tools.name: recallai_list_transcripts
tools.description: List transcripts, optionally for one recording. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/transcript/.

tools.name: recallai_get_transcript
tools.description: Get one transcript: its status, provider and data (the download URL of the transcript JSON). Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/transcript/{id}/.

tools.name: recallai_create_bot
tools.description: Send a recording bot to a meeting now, or at join_at. The bot joins and records, and usage is billed by Recall.ai. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/.

tools.name: recallai_send_chat_message
tools.description: Post a message in the meeting chat as the bot. Other participants see it. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/{id}/send_chat_message/.

tools.name: recallai_leave_call
tools.description: Make the bot leave the meeting now. Recording stops for that bot. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/{id}/leave_call/.

tools.name: recallai_delete_scheduled_bot
tools.description: Delete a scheduled bot that has not joined a call yet. A bot that already joined cannot be deleted this way. Recall.ai API: DELETE /api/v1/bot/{id}/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recallai_list_bots, recallai_get_bot, recallai_list_recordings, recallai_get_recording, recallai_list_transcripts, recallai_get_transcript · Private data: recallai_create_bot · Public sink: recallai_create_bot, recallai_send_chat_message, recallai_leave_call · Destructive: recallai_delete_scheduled_bot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recallai_list_bots, recallai_get_bot, recallai_list_recordings, recallai_get_recording, recallai_list_transcripts, recallai_get_transcript · Private data: recallai_create_bot · Public sink: recallai_create_bot, recallai_send_chat_message, recallai_leave_call · Destructive: recallai_delete_scheduled_bot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
